The Transformer encoder that underlies this reranking accepts four mask and control parameters in its forward signature: an attention mask, a key padding mask, a causal mask, and a return-attention flag, each defaulting to None, None, False, and False respectively. Before iterating over the encoder layers, the encoder conditionally initializes an attention-collection container: when the return-attention flag is set, an empty list is allocated; otherwise the container remains unset. The encoder then applies each layer sequentially to the source representation. Within the layer loop, a branch on the return-attention flag determines the calling convention: when the flag is true, each layer is invoked with the return-attention flag propagated, and the resulting attention weights are appended to the collection; when the flag is false, the layer is invoked without attention-weight collection, and only the transformed source is retained.
